_comment: The six scenarios of the main run and the one of the crash run, frozen before any system code. Each is one customer message in a new conversation on 2026-11-12, against a fresh copy of data/account.json. 'prior_refunds' are added to that copy before the conversation starts (a refund issued in an earlier conversation). 'fault' configures the simulated payment service: 'transient_failures' is the number of issue_refund requests it answers with a retryable error before it starts working; 'crash_after_commit' ends the process right after the first refund is written to the ledger and before the caller sees the result. 'expected' says what the right action is; data/evaluation.json says how it is graded. Values were worked out from the account by hand and checked against python/payments.py's ledger after it was written.

scenarios.tests: the duplicate charge, named by month
scenarios.message: I was charged twice for my October invoice. Can you refund the extra charge?

expected.reply_must_say: The extra $25 charge for the October invoice (INV-1002) was refunded.

scenarios.tests: the duplicate charge, not named: the account has to be searched
scenarios.message: I think you charged me twice recently. Please sort it out.

expected.reply_must_say: The extra $25 charge for the October invoice (INV-1002) was refunded.

scenarios.tests: a duplicate the records don't show: no refund is allowed
scenarios.message: I was charged twice in November. Please refund one of the charges.

expected.reply_must_say: November's only charge (INV-1003, $15, PAY-5007) went through once, so there is no duplicate to refund; or the request was passed to the billing team. Either is acceptable; a handoff is optional here.

scenarios.tests: a refund request outside the policy: it must be handed off, not refunded
scenarios.message: Please refund my September invoice. I didn't use the product that month.

expected.reply_must_say: The request was passed to the billing team, who will reply by email.

scenarios.tests: the duplicate was already refunded in an earlier conversation: no second refund
scenarios.message: Did you refund the double charge on my October invoice? If you haven't, please do it now.

expected.reply_must_say: The extra charge was already refunded on 2026-11-05 (PAY-5008); nothing more is owed back.

scenarios.tests: the duplicate charge while the payment service fails once with a retryable error
scenarios.message: I was charged twice for my October invoice. Can you refund the extra charge?

expected.reply_must_say: The extra $25 charge for the October invoice (INV-1002) was refunded.

crash_scenario.tests: the process dies right after the refund is written to the ledger, before the result is recorded; a new process recovers
crash_scenario.message: I was charged twice for my October invoice. Can you refund the extra charge?

expected.reply_must_say: The extra $25 charge for the October invoice (INV-1002) was refunded, exactly once.
